provenance_note: All client, vendor, designer, and contact data excluded at extraction. K-12 school athletics vertical retained; copy excluded, copy structure retained.

materials_manifest.product: digitally printed graphic on 70/30 perforated one-way vision film
materials_manifest.spec: 70/30 perforation (one-way vision: graphic outside, see-through from inside)

dimensions.note: Applied across a run of ~6 window lites (~35in each) plus an end lite; sized per glazing.

copy_blocks.treatment: continuous graphic spanning a window run, tiled per lite

rules_observations: One-way vision film keeps an exterior-facing spirit graphic while preserving daylight and outward view from inside.
craft_observations: 70/30 perforation balances graphic opacity and see-through; optically clear overlaminate keeps the inside view from hazing.
Tiling a continuous graphic across discrete lites requires registering the art to the mullion spacing.

aesthetic_notes.note: Window graphics extend the athletic brand to the glazing without blocking the rooms behind; appropriate restraint for occupied spaces.

extraction_meta.field_confidence: high on method and film; sizing per glazing
completeness_notes: Perforated film brand not named on the drawing; manufacturer left null (70/30 one-way vision spec is generic/3M-compatible). R3 completeness note, not an unresolved ambiguity.
